parameters.content:
## INPUT
**What:** Takes one project per item from the MAIN: slug, title, repo, vision and the dry_run flag.
**Needs:** Input fields slug, title, repo, vision, dry_run. Nothing is read from the parent.

## READ GITHUB
**What:** Asks GitHub for the issues and open pull requests of the project repo. Read only.
**Needs:** Credential SQ Roadmap GitHub read-only (issues, pull requests, metadata).

## RENDER
**What:** Turns the GitHub answer into one HTML page. A GitHub error stops the run, so nothing is saved.
**Needs:** The GitHub answer and the Start item.

## SAVE
**What:** On a dry run it stops here. Otherwise it saves the page, one row per project.
**Needs:** Data Table roadmap_pages (write): slug, html, updated_at.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "query($owner: String!, $name: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) {\n  issues(first: 100, orderBy: {field: CREATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { pageInfo { hasNextPage } nodes { number title body state closedAt labels(first: 10) { nodes { name } } parent { number } } }\n  pullRequests(states: OPEN, first: 100) { pageInfo { hasNextPage } nodes { number title headRefName isDraft commits(last: 1) { nodes { commit { statusCheckRollup { state } } } } } } } }", variables: { owner: $json.repo.split('/')[0], name: $json.repo.split('/')[1] } }) }}
